## Summary

By request, he publishes the strategy: an image (screenshot of the algo's rules/inputs in what the text implies is NinjaTrader 8), to be run on **3-minute candles with 1-second data** in NT8. His own framing is unusually hedged: "I am NOT confident in this yet, it needs more refinement and forward testing"; as a short-term index algo it is "likely very sensitive to regime changes"; "if you improve it, please share." This is the v0 of the candidate whose out-of-sample stats he posted a day earlier (quoted tweet).

## Why it matters

- **First fully-published Milk-ecosystem scalping algo.** Prior captures were either fully-specified discretionary rules ([[2026-08-30-milk-man-dip-buy-rules]]) or methodology essays ([[2026-09-01-milk-man-backtest-notional-normalization]]). This is a *mechanical* intraday NQ system with the actual logic attached — the strongest replication candidate yet from this author.
- **He applies his own skepticism gates before we have to.** "Sensitive to regime changes" on a 2-trade/day short-term index system is the honest read: September's $4,650 is one month, one regime, out-of-sample or not. His replication standard ([[2026-08-29-milk-man-replication-metrics]]) still applies to his own algo: independent re-backtest across regimes before any live consideration.
- **NT8 + 3-min/1-sec is a stack dependency.** Replication requires NinjaTrader 8 (or reimplementing the logic elsewhere) and careful handling of the 1-second-data condition — intraday backtests are exquisitely sensitive to bar construction, fill assumptions, and session times. Not a copy-paste into our Python stack.
- **"If you improve it, please share" inverts the usual flow** — he's crowd-sourcing the refinement. Improvements circulated by reply-guys deserve extra skepticism; unfalsifiable "works great" replies are noise.
- **Skepticism gates:** image not transcribed at capture (the actual rules live in the screenshot); stats from the quoted tweet are self-reported on his own setup; one month of OOS; author himself disclaims confidence. Interesting, not believed.
